canonical_name: No Quality Information for Internal Control
description: The entity does not obtain or generate and use relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
applicability: Applies to all entities when information systems do not provide timely and accurate data, control monitoring lacks quality metrics, decision-making is not based on reliable information, or data quality processes are absent.

metadata.detection_notes: Review information system capabilities, data quality controls, reporting mechanisms, control dashboards, and evidence of data-driven decision making. Look for absence of control metrics, unreliable or outdated data, or decisions made without supporting information.
